_: The inputs of each ci.yml job a pull request may skip. A path ending in / is a directory (everything under it), any other is one file. On a pull request a job runs when a changed file (git diff --no-renames of the tested merge commit against its base parent) is in `always` or in its list; pushes to trunk and release/production always run every job. Whenever such a job runs, scripts/ci/trace-opens.py records what it opened and `node scripts/ci/job-inputs.cjs verify <job>` fails it on any tracked file outside its list, so a list that misses an input goes red instead of skipping silently.
